title: Link
summary: Navigate within the app using a normal anchor.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Use to or href for the destination. replace chooses history replacement. Standard anchor attributes and onClick are forwarded.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.
sections.code:
<Link href="/tasks/1">Open task</Link>
<Link href="/tasks?sort=title" replace>Sort by title</Link>

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Modified clicks, downloads, external URLs, and non-_self targets retain native browser behavior. onClick runs first and can preventDefault. URL resolution follows normal URL rules relative to the current URL; this is not route-hierarchy-relative resolution.

sections.title: Prefetching
sections.body: prefetch accepts intent (the default), viewport, or none. Intent loads code on hover, focus or touch. Viewport loads code once the link intersects the viewport, using IntersectionObserver; unsupported browsers skip speculative loading. Add prefetchData to run the matched route loader too. This is opt-in: only enable it for loaders safe to execute before a user navigates. It never calls actions or refreshes root data.
sections.code:
<Link to="/tasks" prefetch="viewport" prefetchData>Tasks</Link>
<Link to="/settings" prefetch="intent" prefetchData>Settings</Link>
<Link to="/private" prefetch="none">Private</Link>

sections.title: Data reuse and invalidation
sections.body: Prefetch reads use reason: "prefetch" and the normal clientLoader/server loader transport. The cache is private to one data router, holds at most 16 URLs, and expires after 30 seconds from request start. Path and query identify an entry; hashes share data. A navigation consumes the pending or completed result once. Mutations, explicit revalidation and router disposal invalidate and abort all cached reads. Reads are not cached during tracked mutations. Errors and Response values (including redirects) are retried on navigation; speculative failures never navigate, reload or consume recovery markers. Leaving the viewport does not cancel a shared read; unmounting disconnects observation, and router disposal cancels pending reads.
